grammar_set_note: #63/#283: the size-gated shipped release artifact is built with CBM_GRAMMAR_SET=core (check-release.sh sets it for the release cargo build; cbm-sys/build.rs forwards it to Make and enters it into the libcbm config stamp). `core` compiles only CBM_GRAMMAR_CORE_LANGS (patches/cbm/Makefile.cbm) and links grammar_stubs.c so dropped languages fail closed with a labeled CBM_GRAMMAR_STUBBED error. The Makefile default remains `full`; dev/test builds and the CBM C suite keep every grammar. A `full` release binary is ~263 MiB and intentionally NOT the shipped artifact under this gate.
remediation: The size-gated release artifact must be built with CBM_GRAMMAR_SET=core (check-release.sh sets this for the release cargo build). If this gate fails, the release build was produced with the `full` grammar set (~263 MiB) instead of `core`, or a newly-added core language pulled in a large parser.c. Root cause (issue #63/#191/#283): the DOMINANT payload is the tree-sitter grammar parse tables in libcbm.a - grammar_*.c shims compiling vendored/grammars/*/parser.c (~1.19 GiB of C source; lean 104 MiB, systemverilog 62 MiB) as const data immune to LTO/strip/opt-level. The `core` grammar-subset knob (patches/cbm/Makefile.cbm CBM_GRAMMAR_CORE_LANGS + grammar_stubs.c) drops non-core parser.c and fails closed on dropped languages with a labeled CBM_GRAMMAR_STUBBED error. To restore a dropped language in the shipped artifact, add it to CBM_GRAMMAR_CORE_LANGS (weigh its parser.c size against this gate) rather than raising the threshold. SECONDARY payload ~ the reachable ML stack pulled by calyx-registry (candle-core/candle-nn/candle-transformers) + calyx-ward (fastembed, tokenizers[onig]); ort is load-dynamic so it does NOT embed the ONNX runtime. Note: astrolabe-panel's nomic code_vectors.bin is loaded at runtime via fs::read, not include_bytes!, so it contributes 0 bytes to the binary. Publish a component size breakdown (cargo bloat / bloaty) before changing this threshold.
